Option 3 → × and –

14 - 3 ÷ 27 + 54 × 9 = 21

14 – 1/9 + 54 × 9 = 21

14 – 0.11 + 486 = 21

500 – 0.11 is not equal to 21

Option 4 → ÷ and –

14 × 3 - 27 + 54 ÷ 9 = 21

42 – 27 + 6 = 21

48 – 27 = 21

21 = 21

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.q: Constantan is an alloy of copper and _.
questions.solution:
Constantan is an alloy of copper and nickel.

• It normally consists of 55% copper and 45% nickel.

• Its key characteristic is the low thermal variation of its resistance, which is consistent over a large range of temperatures.

• It was discovered by Edward Weston in 1887.

• It is often used to form thermocouples with wires made of iron, copper, or chromium.

• It has an extremely strong negative Seebeck coefficient above 0 degree Celsius, resulting in good temperature sensitivity.

questions.q: What does 'C' stand for in ITCZ?
questions.solution:
In ITCZ, "C" is stand for Convergence.

• The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) is the zone that covers the Earth, near the equator.

• Where trade winds from the Northern and Southern Hemispheres come together.

• The sun and warm water of the equator heat up the air in the ITCZ, increase its temperature, and keep it buoyant.

• With the aid of the convergence of the industrial winds, the buoyant air is rising.

• When the air increases, it spreads and cools, releasing concentrated heat in an almost endless cycle of thunderstorms.

questions.q: The rating for a fuse used in a household electric circuit is provided on the basis of:
questions.solution:
The rating for a fuse used in a household electric circuit is provided on the basis of the current.

• The fuse is used to provide overcurrent protection.

• The main component is a metal wire or strip that melts when too much current flows through it, stopping or interrupting the current.

• It is a sacrificial device; once the fuse has been operated, the open circuit must be replaced or rewired, depending on the type.

• The Wiring Regulations usually define the maximum current rate of fuse for particular circuits.

• Short circuits, overload, uneven loads, or device failure are the primary or some of the reasons for fuse operation.

questions.q: Which among the following is a non-biodegradable waste?
questions.solution:
Plastic is a non-biodegradable waste.

Key Points

• Non-biodegradable material can be characterized as a category of substance that can not be broken down by natural organisms and acts as a source of pollution.

• Non-biodegradable waste is a waste that can not be decomposed or dissolved by natural chemicals.

• They have existed on earth for thousands of years without any deterioration.

• Dead animals, Vegetables and Flowers are the biodegradable waste.

• Biodegradable material can be described as a substance that can be decomposed by bacteria or other natural organisms and does not contribute to pollution.

• Biodegradable waste is waste material that is and can be contaminated by natural causes such as organisms (e.g. bacteria, fungi, etc.), abiotic elements such as temperature, UV, oxygen, etc.

questions.q: In which state is the festival of Uttarayan uniquely celebrated?
questions.solution:
The festival of Uttarayan is celebrated in Gujarat.

Key Points

• This festival is also known as Makar Sankranti.

• It is a festival day in the Hindu calendar, devoted to the God of Surya (Sun).

• It is celebrated every year in the lunar month of Magha, which corresponds to the month of January according to the Gregorian calendar, and is the day when the people of India celebrate their harvest.

questions.q: How many molecules of ATP are obtained by the anaerobic respiration of one molecule of glucose?
questions.solution:
• 2 molecules of ATP are obtained by the anaerobic respiration of one molecule of glucose.

• Respiration is a glucose degradation mechanism with the aid of molecular oxygen to generate ATP.

• It requires both glycolysis and phosphorylation.

• Glycolysis is the first step of glucose degradation that occurs in the absence of oxygen and transforms one glucose molecule into two pyruvate molecules.

• During this cycle, 4 ATP molecules are generated and 2 ATP molecules are consumed.

questions.q: If 5 divided the integer n, the remainder is 2. What will be remainder if 7n is divided by 5?
questions.solution:
Let n = 7, then condition satisfied.

Hence, 7n = 7 × 7 = 49

Now, 49 ÷ 5, then remainder is 4.

Let the number be 5x.

Then, The integer n = 5x + 2

Take x = 1

Then, n = 7

The value of 7n = 49

49 divided by 5 leaves the remainder 4

∴ 4 is the remainder if 7n is divided by 5.

questions.q: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 280900 in 2 years at 6% per annum, interest compounded annually. The sum is:

questions.q: A, B and C can individually complete a task in 24 days, 16 days and 32 days respectively. If A and C start the work and worked for 6 days and left, then the number of days required by B to complete the remaining task, is:

= 3x × 1/3 = x

questions.q: When 2 is subtracted from each of the given n numbers, then the sum of the numbers so obtained is 102. When 5 is subtracted from each of them, then the sum of the numbers so obtained is 12. What is the average of the given n numbers?

Formula Used:

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

Calculation:

Let the sum of n numbers be x, then

According to the question

x – 2n = 102 …(1)

x – 5n = 12 …(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation (2)

3n = 90

⇒ n = 30

From equation (1)

x – 60 = 102

⇒ x = 102 + 60 = 162

∴ Average of first n numbers = 162/30 = 5.4

questions.q: A train X travelling at 60 km/h overtakes another train Y, 225 m long, and completely passes it in 72 seconds. If the trains had been going in opposite directions, they would have passed each other in 18 seconds. The length (in m) of X and the speed (in km/h) of Y are, respectively:
questions.solution:

As we know,

Time = Distance/speed

Multiply by 4 in equation (2)

72 = frac{{4( {225 + l} )}}{{( {60 + x} )(5)/({18)}}} …3)

From equation (1) and equation (3)

frac{{4( {225 + l} )}}{{( {60 + x} )(5)/({18)}}} = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 - x} )(5)/({18)}}}

⇒ 4 (60 – x) = (60 + x)

⇒ 240 – 4x = 60 + x

⇒ 4x + x = 240 – 60

⇒ 5x = 180

⇒ x = 36

∴ Speed of train Y is 36 km/hr

From equation (1)

72 = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 - 36} )(5)/({18)}}}

⇒ 72 × 24 × 5/18 = 225 + l

⇒ 480 = 225 + l

⇒ l = 480 – 225

⇒ l = 255 m

∴ Length of train X is 255 m

questions.q:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. They also visit ailing friends and relatives or attend to personal matters even during office hours.

B. Once in office, they receive friends and relatives who call them any time without prior appointment.

C. We can frequently find a large number of people sitting here and there and doing nothing.

D. Even those who are employed often come late to office and leave early unless they are forced to be punctual.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. CDBA.

• C is the sentence that establishes the subject matter. Hence, it'll be the first sentence after rearrangement.

• D starts with 'even those' which refers to people mentioned in C. Hence, D follows C.

• Sentence B is the logical successor of D as it talks about people in the office mentioned in D.

• Last comes A as it uses 'also' and elaborates sentence B.

Sentences after rearrangement-

*We can frequently find a large number of people sitting here and there and doing nothing. Even those who are employed often come late to office and leave early unless they are forced to be punctual. Once in office, they receive friends and relatives who call them any time without prior appointment. They also visit ailing friends and relatives or attend to personal matters even during office hours.*

• Example: She acted as a surrogate during her colleague's maternity leave.
